slots.title: Concurrency & Automation: x86_64 Tokio/Rayon Runtime + Скрипты экономии токенов
slots.description: Разделение потоков исполнения: Tokio для асинхронной сети, Rayon для тяжелых CPU-задач (картинки/видео), rtrb для звука. Разработка автоматических скриптов для рутинных задач ИИ.

slots.title: Window Shell
slots.description: Frameless window with native titlebar, window geometry save/restore, multi-monitor boundary protection, minimum dimensions 940×500 (default 1280×720), transparency and blur support. Target: Native Client: Shell Layer. Criteria: Window persists geometry across restarts; respects minimum bounds; remains visible when monitor topologies change

slots.title: System Tray
slots.description: System tray icon with unread indicator status, context menu (Open, About, Restart, Quit), toggle window visibility on click, start minimized option. Target: Shell: System Tray. Criteria: Clicking tray icon hides/shows main window; unread counter updates icon state; Quit terminates process cleanly

slots.title: Unread Badges
slots.description: Unread message counter badge: Linux Unity/Freedesktop D-Bus launcher, Windows taskbar overlay icon, macOS dock badge; numeric 1–10, overflow dot indicator, 0 clears. Target: Shell: OS Integration. Criteria: Badge visible on desktop launcher/dock/taskbar; 0 clears badge; overflow renders dot; configurable in settings

slots.title: System Autostart (Autostart)
slots.description: Autostart on OS login: Windows/macOS login items, Linux XDG `.desktop`/portal; flag `--start-minimized`. Target: shell: autostart. Criteria: Settings toggle reliably manages autostart on all three OSes; starts minimized without window flicker

slots.title: Deep Links & Single Instance
slots.description: URL scheme handler `discord://` (route URLs to channels, guilds, or voice), second process invocation focuses existing window instead of duplicating. Target: Shell: Deep Link Router. Criteria: Clicking `discord://...` URL navigates directly to target channel; launching binary twice activates active instance

slots.title: Desktop Notifications
slots.description: Native OS notifications; clicking notification raises and focuses target channel window; configurable notification sound and taskbar flashing. Target: Shell: Notification Service. Criteria: Clicking notification focuses chat view; taskbar flashing adheres to settings; persistent configuration across restarts

slots.title: Application Updater
slots.description: Startup update verification, download progress display, snooze/skip version options, atomic binary swap, and cryptographic signature validation. Target: Updater Service. Criteria: Updates download with visible progress; snooze/skip flags persist; release binary signatures verified before swap

slots.title: Distribution Packaging
slots.description: Cross-platform packages: Debian/Ubuntu `.deb`, RPM, AppImage, Flatpak (Linux), WiX MSI (Windows), DMG (macOS); desktop entries, icons, MIME types. Target: Release Pipeline. Criteria: Clean installation on Linux, Windows, and macOS; desktop launcher and icons register correctly

slots.title: Store Metadata
slots.description: Metadata manifests for package distribution repositories: Flathub `metainfo.xml`, Windows Winget manifests, release channels (stable, canary). Target: Release Pipeline. Criteria: Manifests pass linter validation; release channel selectable at build time

slots.title: Splash Screen & About Dialog
slots.description: Splash screen displayed during cold boot initialization, first-time user tour, About dialog displaying component version numbers and license info. Target: Shell: Onboarding & About. Criteria: Splash dismisses smoothly when main window paints; tour state persists; About dialog reflects exact commit and version

slots.title: Spellchecker
slots.description: Native spellchecker: multi-language dictionary support, inline error highlight, context menu suggestions, add-to-dictionary support. Target: UI: Composer Component. Criteria: Misspelled words highlighted with squiggly underline; replacement and custom dictionary additions function correctly

slots.title: Configuration Store
slots.description: Persistent user preferences (JSON store, schema validation, default merge, reactive change listeners), comprehensive settings window. Target: Core: Settings Engine. Criteria: Preferences persist across application restarts; settings UI exposes all keys; reset-to-defaults functions reliably

slots.title: Audio Capture (PipeWire)
slots.description: Capture desktop audio via PipeWire loopback and publish a virtual microphone source (2 channels, 48 kHz, s16le) for WebRTC streaming. Target: Capture Service (`pipewire-rs`). Criteria: Desktop sound routes into WebRTC voice stream; virtual loopback device cleanly registered

slots.title: Audio Node Filtering
slots.description: Exclude client's own audio stream, input microphones, and virtual monitoring sinks from capture; capture only application audio to prevent echo. Target: Capture Service. Criteria: System audio streaming excludes own microphone input; no acoustic feedback loops; filter rules configurable

slots.title: Stream Audio Configuration
slots.description: Modal controls: start muted, desktop sound isolation, exclude inputs, granular per-application audio source selection. Target: UI: Voice & Streaming. Criteria: Options persist and dynamically update audio node routing; helpful tooltips explain routing behaviors

slots.title: Stream Source Selector
slots.description: Source selection grid with live thumbnails, monitor vs window tabs, resolution presets (480p–1440p) and frame rates (15–60 FPS), audio toggle. Target: UI: Streaming Modal. Criteria: Selecting source initiates stream; target resolution, framerate, and audio flags apply to encoder pipeline

slots.title: High-Res Source Thumbnails
slots.description: On-demand high-resolution thumbnail generation (1920×1080) on source hover or selection while keeping the initial picker list responsive. Target: UI: Streaming Modal. Criteria: Selected thumbnail renders crisp high-res preview; source list remains smooth and responsive

slots.title: Wayland ScreenCast Portal
slots.description: On Wayland environments with system portal choosers, bypass redundant custom picker and delegate directly to `xdg-desktop-portal`. Target: Capture Service: Wayland Portal. Criteria: Stream initiates via native portal dialog without dual picker prompts; full native display resolution preserved

slots.title: Windows Loopback Audio
slots.description: Capture system desktop audio via WASAPI loopback interface without requiring third-party virtual audio cables. Target: Capture Service: Windows WASAPI. Criteria: Audio stream captures system output on Windows 10/11 out-of-the-box; clear diagnostics on legacy OS versions

slots.title: Media Constraints Engine
slots.description: Custom media constraint negotiation: virtual audio track injection, exact `deviceId` matching, AGC policy, resolution bounds. Target: Voice Engine. Criteria: Audio track remains stable through device changes; video encoder adheres strictly to selected resolution bounds

slots.title: Stream Quality Profiles
slots.description: Dynamic bitrate and encoder scaling: min/target/max bitrate, framerate, resolution pixel limits, connection adaptation. Target: Voice Engine. Criteria: Stream adheres to selected profile (e.g. 720p@60 FPS); bitrate conforms to bandwidth constraints

slots.title: Stream Lifecycle & Streamer Mode
slots.description: Handle `STREAM_CREATE`, `STREAM_SERVER_UPDATE`, and `STREAM_DELETE` events; automatic streamer mode toggle to hide sensitive personal data. Target: Core: Event Dispatcher. Criteria: Stream lifecycle events update UI state; streamer mode automatically suppresses tokens, invite links, and notifications

slots.title: Stream Viewer & Picture-in-Picture
slots.description: In-client stream playback viewer with fullscreen toggle, audio volume slider, overlay controls, and automatic PiP floating window. Target: UI: Stream Player. Criteria: Active streams render with low latency; changing channels detaches player to persistent floating PiP window

slots.title: Steam Deck & Controller Mode
slots.description: Handheld UI mode: dynamic scaling for Steam Deck Game Mode, gamepad navigation support via D-Pad/thumbstick, virtual keyboard triggering via D-Bus. Target: UI: Platform Navigation. Criteria: Full navigation possible via gamepad buttons; input fields automatically summon SteamOS on-screen keyboard

slots.title: D-Bus Desktop Integration
slots.description: Linux D-Bus desktop interface implementation: MPRIS media controls, screen-saver inhibition during calls, power management integration. Target: Platform: Linux D-Bus. Criteria: Client responds to media key shortcuts; system sleep is prevented during active voice calls or streams

slots.title: Windows Platform (Windows-specific)
slots.description: Taskbar badge overlays, portable mode (isolated data alongside executable), Alt+F4/Ctrl+Q hotkeys. Target: Windows Platform. Criteria: Portable build does not touch AppData or registry; unread badge visible on taskbar icon

slots.title: macOS Platform (macOS-specific)
slots.description: Vibrancy material window, native traffic lights controls, `open-url` deep links, notarization and entitlements. Target: macOS Platform. Criteria: Signed and notarized dmg; window with Vibrancy material; links open via custom protocol

slots.title: Diagnostic Inspection Window
slots.description: Built-in developer diagnostic window: WebRTC stats visualizer, gateway connection logs, frame rendering timeline, memory metrics. Target: UI: Diagnostics. Criteria: Diagnostic window displays real-time RTT, packet loss, frame time histograms, and memory consumption stats

slots.title: Client Cache & State Reset
slots.description: Settings action to purge local SQLite message cache, temporary media thumbnails, or reset local preferences without losing credentials. Target: Core: Store Engine. Criteria: Cache purge frees disk space; local settings reset restores default values while keeping login tokens intact

slots.title: Custom Themes Engine
slots.description: Runtime theme loader supporting CSS variables and token overrides for custom appearance (Dark, Light, Midnight OLED, Solarized). Target: UI: Theme Provider. Criteria: Custom themes apply immediately without application restart; UI elements maintain WCAG 2.2 contrast compliance

slots.title: Localization & Asset Downloader
slots.description: Dynamic background downloader for regional font subsets, emoji packs, and audio cues with local caching and SHA-256 validation. Target: Core: Asset Manager. Criteria: Localization strings and font assets download asynchronously on first use; cached locally with verified hashes

slots.title: Clipboard Formatting & Rich Pasting
slots.description: Intelligent clipboard paste handler: detect file drops, image clipboard data, markdown URL wrapping, code block detection. Target: UI: Composer Component. Criteria: Pasting images queues upload in attachment shelf; pasting links over highlighted text generates markdown links

slots.title: Voice Activity & Audio HUD
slots.description: Visual voice activity detection overlay (green speaking ring, input volume meter, noise gate calibration slider). Target: UI: Voice HUD. Criteria: Speaking indicator triggers with low latency; noise floor slider visually demonstrates gate cutoff threshold

slots.title: Gateway Initial State (`READY`)
slots.description: Complete schema and capture of initial gateway connection state: user accounts, guild lists, channel structures, member roles. Target: Protocol Core. Criteria: Full `READY` payload schema parsed into strongly-typed structs; documented in `docs/re/gateway-protocol.md`

slots.title: REST API Routes & Payloads
slots.description: Inventory of REST API v9 endpoints: HTTP method, URL path, request body schema, authentication headers, rate limits. Target: Network BFF. Criteria: Route catalog covers authentication, messaging, search, channels, and guilds; documented in `docs/re/rest-d02.md`

slots.title: UI Component Interaction Traces
slots.description: Empirical UI contracts: channel sidebar, chat scroll virtualization, emoji picker, user popouts, settings navigation. Target: UI Architecture. Criteria: Component specs define DOM hierarchy, CSS tokens, keyboard bindings, and ARIA roles; documented in `docs/re/frontend-d03.md`

slots.title: Media Capture Constraints Protocol
slots.description: Detailed contract of Discord's media device selection, AGC algorithms, noise suppression flags, and stream renegotiation. Target: Voice Engine. Criteria: Complete specification of audio capture parameters, echo cancellation options, and sample rate requirements

slots.title: Streaming Protocol Wire Contracts
slots.description: Resolution parameters, video codec negotiation (H.264, AV1), RTP packetization rules, and voice opcodes `18..=22`. Target: Media Engine. Criteria: Full wire contract specification for WebRTC screen share signaling, RTP framing, and keyframe request opcodes

slots.title: Notification Defaults Protocol
slots.description: Client decision heuristics for default notification states (`isPlatformEmbedded`, channel notification settings overrides). Target: Notification Engine. Criteria: Specification of server-level vs channel-level notification cascades, mention sound rules, and mute inheritance

slots.title: Session Resilience & Security
slots.description: Session token protection, secure keyring storage, recovery from abrupt connection dropouts, rate limit backoff. Target: Auth & Storage. Criteria: Session recovery protocol handles Opcode 6 Resume; secure token storage in OS keyring with automatic masking

slots.title: Platform Privacy Guardrails
slots.description: WebRTC IP leakage prevention policy, MediaSession key bindings isolation, auto-play media audio suppression. Target: Platform Shell. Criteria: Comprehensive privacy checklist for native client implementation ensuring user IP and telemetry protection

slots.title: packageVersion hardening & corrupted line counter in walk-log
slots.description: Wrap packageVersion in try-catch, protect parseCallLog against corrupted lines, verify package.json engines

slots.title: Command diff: comparing two inventories/reports
slots.description: Script for automated diffing of two inventories or JSONL telemetry reports without token usage
